essayTitle: Report on the Visit to Pawfect Haven Animal Shelter
source: SPM 2026 Trial · Perlis · English Paper 2 · Part 3 Q3 · Report, 200–250 words
paragraphs: This report is about the visit to Pawfect Haven Animal Shelter in Kangar organised by the Nature Lovers Club on 16 August 2026. A total of 30 members and two teacher advisors took part.

The first aim of the visit was to raise members' awareness of animal welfare. Members learnt about the plight of abandoned pets and the importance of responsible ownership. The second aim was to cultivate a spirit of volunteerism among members. The club hoped members would contribute their time and energy to a worthy cause.

First and foremost, members cleaned the kennels and bathed the dogs. Despite the strong odour, everyone rolled up their sleeves and worked tirelessly. Furthermore, members attended a talk by the shelter's veterinarian. She explained how to care for rescued animals and why neutering is essential.

Firstly, the school could organise a donation drive to collect pet food and supplies for animal shelters. This would ease the shelter's financial burden. Secondly, students could help promote pet adoption on social media. This would help more animals find loving homes.
In conclusion, the visit was meaningful and eye-opening. It is hoped that similar visits will be held regularly so that more students can lend a helping hand to these voiceless creatures.
